en_title: GTA 6: How Microtransactions and GTA + Benefits Work
opus_summary: 预购《GTA6》可获一个月免费GTA+会员，福利包括商店折扣、专属载具及更轻松赚取游戏内现金的方式，并可在设置中关闭。预购奖励须于2027年3月31日前兑换，此后除非取消，否则将自动续订，每月收费7.99美元(约合人民币53元)或6.99英镑(约合人民币62元)。

paragraphs.en: Anyone who pre-ordered GTA 6 is entitled to one free month of GTA +, Rockstar’s subscription service. It's been around for a while now, proving worthwhile for fans of GTA Online who get exclusive items and opportunities in the game through it, as well as access to a library of the developer’s games, including the likes of GTA 5, Red Dead Redemption, and Bully. But it also comes with fresh benefits for those playing GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 所有预购《GTA6》的人都可免费获得一个月的GTA+，即Rockstar的订阅服务。这项服务推出已有一段时间，事实证明，它对《GTA Online》的粉丝来说物有所值：他们可以通过它在游戏中获得专属物品和机会，还能游玩该开发商游戏库中的作品，包括《GTA5》《荒野大镖客：救赎》和《恶霸鲁尼》等。但它也为《GTA6》玩家带来了新的权益。

paragraphs.en: These bonuses include store discounts, exclusive vehicles, and ways to make earning in-game cash easier. It’s not quite pay-to-win due to the small advantages it gives and GTA 6’s nature as a single-player game, but it will certainly give a leg up to those with a GTA+ subscription.
paragraphs.cn: 这些奖励包括商店折扣、专属载具，以及让赚取游戏内现金更容易的途径。由于它带来的优势较小，而且《GTA6》是一款单人游戏，这还算不上花钱取胜，但它肯定会让GTA+订阅用户占据一定优势。

paragraphs.en: All of the listed benefits, which can be found on the in-game store page, can be found here:
paragraphs.cn: 游戏内商店页面列出的全部权益都可以在这里找到：

paragraphs.en: Crucially, if you have signed up for GTA+, but want to experience the purest form of GTA 6 possible, these benefits can be switched off in the game’s settings menu. The pre-order bonus must be redeemed before March 31, 2027, and will renew automatically unless cancelled, costing $7.99/£6.99 per month after that. Of course, we are yet to hear anything about GTA 6’s potential online component, and how GTA+ may play into that equation.
paragraphs.cn: 重要的是，如果你订阅了GTA+，但想尽可能体验最纯粹的《GTA6》，可以在游戏设置菜单中关闭这些权益。预购奖励必须在2027年3月31日之前领取，并且除非取消，否则将自动续订，此后每月费用为7.99美元/6.99英镑。当然，我们尚未听到任何有关《GTA6》潜在在线内容的消息，也不知道GTA+可能会在其中扮演什么角色。

paragraphs.en: All GTA 6 pre-orders also come with the Vintage Vice City, which can be purchased separately if you’re planning to buy the game after launch. Here are the details on what’s included, all of which become available in Chapter 3 of the story .
paragraphs.cn: 所有《GTA6》预购版本还附带Vintage Vice City；如果你打算在游戏发售后购买，也可以单独购买它。以下是其中所含内容的详情，所有内容都会在故事第三章开放。

paragraphs.en: If you bought the Ultimate Edition , then we have a list of all of the bonuses that come with that listed here, as well as when in the game you can gain access to those exclusive vehicles, weapons, and cosmetics.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你购买了终极版，我们在这里列出了该版本附带的所有奖励，以及你在游戏中何时可以获得那些专属载具、武器和外观物品。

paragraphs.en: We’ve got plenty more GTA 6 for you here at IGN. You can check out our review , or head over to our launch live blog , where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: IGN还有大量关于《GTA6》的内容。你可以查看我们的评测，或者前往我们的发售实时报道页面，我会在那里尽力回答你们可能提出的尽可能多的有关这款游戏的不涉及剧透的问题。
